method.basis: one deterministic uncentred PCA rank-64 basis fit only on candidate residual rows reached by the four training folds; the held-out fold contributes no basis, codebook, pair, weight, or hyperparameter information
method.baseline: Faiss ProductQuantizer fit without labels on the same fold-training coefficients, seed, iterations, and payload
method.challenger: one cutoff-weighted closed-form centroid update with the baseline assignments frozen during the update, followed by ordinary nearest-centroid re-encoding

cutoff_pair_mining.promotion: known positive at Base ranks 11..40 versus an unjudged Base Top-10 challenger when same-candidate exact prefers the positive
cutoff_pair_mining.protection: known positive in Base Top-10 versus an unjudged rank 11..26 challenger when same-candidate exact prefers the positive

cutoff_weighting.block_sensitivity: squared L2 norm of the PCA-projected query within each four-dimensional RPQ block, normalized to sum to one per pair
cutoff_weighting.documents_receiving_pair_mass: both the known-positive and unjudged-challenger residual rows
cutoff_weighting.normalization: within each block, active residual rows receive mean additive boost eight before clipping

centroid_update.empty_cell_policy: remain byte-identical to the unsupervised centroid
centroid_update.objective: weighted within-cell coefficient squared error plus anchor_pseudocount times squared centroid drift

rpq_training.implementation: Faiss ProductQuantizer on fixed PCA coefficients
